name: NTA
summary: A proposed Hawaiian optical array builds on Ashra technology to survey PeV–EeV tau neutrinos with high-resolution imaging of upward air showers.
detection_principle: Separated wide-field Cherenkov and fluorescence stations would observe showers from taus produced by Earth-skimming neutrinos. Stereo geometry would constrain shower direction and reject backgrounds.

sites.name: Hawaii Island proposed network
sites.location: Candidate mountain and central sites on Hawaii Island

status.label: Proposed
